summary: Phoenix New Media filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing covers routine quarterly disclosures, including revenue up 21.6% YoY to RMB188.8M, gross profit increase, and management commentary on strategy. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, restructuring, etc.) is referenced. The filing is a standard earnings release with a conference call notice. Non-GAAP reconciliations are included but no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are disclosed. This is a routine current report with no special situation event.
